verdict.rationale: The docs say users can choose to have "your Playwright/Puppeteer code connect directly over CDP" to cloud browsers. They also describe launching a browser, connecting to its CDP URL, then stopping it, and position Browser Infrastructure as a remote browser for your own agents. That covers bringing existing automation code without rewriting it. Missing for 10: detailed per-framework connection examples (Playwright vs. Puppeteer specifics, compatibility caveats) and independent or hands-on corroboration that existing scripts work unchanged.
